product.title: Edinburgh: West Highland Lochs, Mountains & Castles

description.text: Leave Edinburgh for West Highland lochs and castles, starting at Doune Castle before Inveraray, Loch Awe, and Kilchurn Castle. The 9-hour-45-minute coach day includes free time in Inveraray and views toward the Arrochar Alps on the return. Stops include Doune Castle, Inveraray, Loch Awe, Kilchurn Castle. A knowledgeable driver-guide provides live commentary through Glen Ogle and loch-side pullouts; attraction tickets are listed separately. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided West Highland lochs and castles day without self-driving mountain roads.

highlights: Full-day tour of the West Highlands’ lochs and castles from Edinburgh
Travel deep into the Scottish Highlands, home to the mighty Arrochar Alps
Admire the tranquil lakes and soaking peaks of the Highlands in Glen Ogle
